column2: "Account smithj31 was compromised by password guessing (17 failed attempts, then a successful sign-in from Romania at 02:31 without MFA). In the next 27 minutes, 6 files (28.1 MB) were downloaded from the FSB shared drive, including payroll, an employee roster, and survey responses with PII, and fsb_shared/README.txt was overwritten at 02:57 (restored from the drive's version history)."
"Notify the owners of the 6 downloaded files, starting with the PII export"
"Block the source address 203.0.113.57 and review sign-ins from outside the US"
"Incident closed. Open the replay address above in your browser to watch the incident unfold from the two files you imported, then look up: your seat is lit red on the projector board."
